title: The Rain, 2027
logline: The last January. The garage sill; rain; the three jars; the sand dollar; the pup asleep; the lamp on; the page under the lamp is a mudflat — spring, already, in January.

panels.composition: The window in rain from inside, the jars, the sand dollar, the pup asleep in the bed — twelve now, gray — and under the lamp on the table, a page in progress that is not rain at all: the mudflats in sun, gold, the first of the spring pages, begun in January. The rain outside; the sun on the table.
props: the spring page under the lamp

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, a garage studio in January rain seen from inside with three jars and a sand dollar on the sill, an old gray three-legged dog asleep in a bed beneath, and on the lit drafting table a watercolor page in progress showing sunlit golden mudflats, rain outside and sun on the table, no words

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards

notes: The last Rain. Spring already on the table.
